editorial:
Ever wonder what happens when a bad cop goes too far? You get this gritty story about a guy who thinks he is smarter than everyone else. He runs a drug scam and decides to pin the whole thing on his own partner to save his own skin. The vibe is dark and tense, making you feel the pressure as the lies start to pile up. It is a classic setup where the main character creates a trap that he eventually falls into himself, and you will find yourself rooting for the partner to get some payback.

The acting is solid and keeps you hooked even when the story slows down. You will love the twists, though some parts of the plot feel a bit slow in the middle. If you like crime stories with a lot of betrayal, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: In the end, the shady cop finds out that his partner was actually one step ahead of him the whole time. Just as he thinks he has won, the evidence is flipped back on him. He gets arrested for the very crimes he tried to pin on his friend. It wraps up with a satisfying punch because the bad guy loses everything and ends up behind bars, proving that crime does not pay.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves police dramas and stories about betrayal.
